# Mike Finizza 

Michael Theodore Finizza is a Hot Wheels designer who has worked with Mattel from 2002 to 2020. Prior to his work at Mattel, he was originally an intern creating "feature dolls" for the Barbie line of products. He is currently employed by competing brand Spin Master as a Staff Designer.
